recognize_zh: 箭頭指的是一顆小細胞，圓形細胞核染色質緻密呈塊狀，外圍有一圈灰藍色細胞質，大小接近紅血球，是周邊血液中的有核紅血球（nucleated red blood cell）。
features: Small cell (arrow) roughly the size of a red cell with a round, dense nucleus
Coarsely clumped, condensed chromatin without nucleoli
A grayish polychromatophilic red cell present at the left of the field
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional irregular forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a nucleated red blood cell with a small round nucleus with dense clumped chromatin and a thin rim of polychromatophilic cytoplasm, consistent with a late (polychromatophilic to orthochromatic) normoblast. A polychromatophilic red cell is also present, and the background red cells show mild anisocytosis. Circulating nucleated red cells reflect accelerated erythropoiesis, marrow stress, or marrow infiltration and should be counted per 100 white cells with correction of the WBC count. Findings are consistent with a circulating nucleated red cell, as seen in hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes are slightly larger with a thin rim of clear sky-blue cytoplasm and less pyknotic, smudgier chromatin.
Accompanied by immature granulocytes and teardrop cells rather than isolated nucleated red cells with polychromasia.
A platelet on a red cell shows granular purple material within a pink cell outline rather than a nucleus with its own cytoplasmic rim.
